column1: # Mogall's route marker and the Lamakan Desert's heat and ash-thick air.

column3: The broken sign reads:{page_break}North: Fuchin Temple\nSouth: Mogall Forest{end_wait}
The sand burns through\nmy boots. We can't\nstay here long.{end_wait}
Every step sinks.\nThere's no firm ground\nanywhere.{end_wait}
I can't catch my breath.\nThe heat is making\nme dizzy.{end_wait}
The wind carries sand\ninto my eyes. I can\nbarely see ahead.{end_wait}
The ground is hot\neven in the shade.\nHow can that be?{end_wait}
My clothes are stiff\nwith sweat and dust.\nI need water.{end_wait}
My feet hurt. I can't\nkeep this pace\nfor much longer.{end_wait}
How far is the oasis?\nI can't see anything\nbut sand.{end_wait}
If we don't find water,\nwe'll never make it\nout of here.{end_wait}
